description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class, which provides REST endpoints for interacting with an employee directory. It includes methods for retrieving single employee data and listing employees with filtering options, and uses various API components, models, and services related to employee directory management within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPI
classes.description: REST API class for managing employee directory data, supporting retrieval of individual and list of employees with filtering and pagination.
